newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Northeast peak power rises amid chill, snow.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Northeast peak power rises amid chill, snow.

text.p: Wholesale electricity prices for delivery during heavy demand hours rose Tuesday amid frigid weather covering the region and heavy snowfall reported in some areas.
Niagara Mohawk Power Corp said portions of Oswego County in upstate New York was buried under nearly two feet of snow overnight.
Far below-normal temperatures supported heating demand during evening through early morning hours.
Higher usage was offset by a couple of nuclear generating units resuming operation.
The 470 megawatt (MW) Ginna and 610 MW Nine Mile Point unit nuclear power units, both in western New York, were in restart mode following recent unplanned outages.
"Transmission will get loaded, and the power will stay there," said a New York trader, referring to the startups of those two units.

In the western part of the New York Power Pool (NYPP) district, peak, non-firm electricity for Wednesday delivery was quoted at $22.00-$23.00 a megawatt hour (MWh), unchanged from Monday's range for Tuesday.
Western NYPP power for non-firm delivery during light load hours on Wednesday held steady at $13.50-$14.50.
In the eastern part of NYPP, peak, non-firm electricity for Wednesday was assessed at $30.00-$32.00, up sharply from Monday's $26.00-$27.00.
Off-peak, non-firm Wednesday electricity in eastern NYPP held steady at $16.00-$18.00.

In the New England Power Pool (NEPOOL), peak, non-firm electricity for Wednesday at the Northeast Utilities border was quoted at $33.00-$37.00, a wider range than Monday's $34.00-$36.00. A deal was heard done at $35.50.
"The spread was so wide. There wasn't much getting done," said a Northeast marketer.
Non-firm, off-peak NEPOOL power for next-day delivery to the NU border was pegged at $20.00-$21.00, flat from Monday's range for Tuesday.

The New York Power Authority confirmed it restored a 765 kilovolt (KV) transmission power line from Quebec to New York to normal operation last weekend after shutting two segments of the line the previous weekend for seasonal maintenance.
